english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.

This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DB08

(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £50 to £60 as from 1/07/13.
(ii) See section 87(4A) for defence.
(iii) Offence is as amended by section 18 of the Clean Neighbourhoods and Environment Act 2005.
